name: railway_list_deployments
description: INSPECT a service's recent deployments and their status. Requires `serviceId` and `environmentId` (both from railway_get_project); `projectId` optional to narrow. Returns up to 5 deployments newest-first: each node has `id`, `status` (e.g. SUCCESS, BUILDING, DEPLOYING, FAILED, CRASHED, REMOVED), `createdAt`, `url`/`staticUrl` (the live deployment URL), and `canRedeploy`. Use this to answer 'is the service up / did the last deploy succeed / what's the current URL', and to find a deployment `id` before rolling back. Read-only.

projectId.description: Optional project id (from railway_list_projects) to scope the query.

body_defaults.query: query deployments($input: DeploymentListInput!) { deployments(first: 5, input: $input) { edges { node { id status createdAt url staticUrl canRedeploy } } } }
